test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23rd November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

L _ _ K C _ O Q _ C L O _ _ C
solution:
Given: L _ _ K C _ O Q _ C L O _ _ C

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

**1) OQLKQK → **L **__O__** **__Q__** K C **-** **__L__** O Q **__K__** C - L O **__Q__** **__K__** C

Here "L O Q K C" is repeated itself.

2) QOLKQK → L **__Q__** **__O__** K C - __L__ O Q __K__ C - L O __Q__ __K__ C

**3) **OQLOQC → L __O__ __Q__ K C - __L__ O Q **__O__** C - L O __Q__ **__C__** C

4) OKOQCQ → L __O__ **__K__** K C - **__O__** O Q **__Q__** C - L O **__C__** **__Q__** C

 
• Option (1) gives a pattern of **L O Q K C** - L O Q K C - **L O Q K C.**

Hence, ‘OQLKQK’ is the correct answer.
